_real_world.class: Type 346B (H/LJG-346B) S-band dual-band AESA, 4 large planar faces + 4 smaller X-band mast panels
_real_world.variant_scope: Type 055 (Renhai) only; about 40% larger aperture than Type 052D's Type 346A.
public_equipment: 4x X-band multifunction mast panels (fire control / horizon search)

_provenance.modeling_note: Primary S-band AESA for Type 055, confirmed by a CCTV report relayed by Janes as a dual-band system with 4 large planar faces plus 4 smaller mast panels. No A/B detection-range figure exists; the 400-600 km band is a forum-grade estimate reasoned from a 40% aperture increase over Type 346A, modeled here as a single merged-radar record per engine convention.

sensor.type.note: Type 346B is an AESA radar; Radar is the matching engine sensor type

sensor.max_range.note: no A/B detection-range figure; forum estimate ~500-600 km against large high-altitude targets; used 480000.0 m as a conservative point within that C-only band, per authoring guidance to avoid overstating an unsourced figure

sensor.fov_deg.note: 4 large planar faces give full 360-deg coverage; engine models one merged radar, not per-face FOV

sensor.scan_period.note: no public scan-rate figure; engineering estimate consistent with a large 4-face AESA volume-search radar

sensor.detection_prob.note: no public Pd figure; engineering estimate slightly above the Fujian island-radar proxy given Type 346B's larger, more mature, dedicated fit

sensor.bearing_noise_std.note: no public bearing-accuracy figure; engineering estimate for a large fixed-face AESA

sensor.range_noise_std.note: no public range-accuracy figure; engineering estimate for a large fixed-face AESA

sensor.track_memory_s.note: no public track-coast figure; engineering estimate consistent with a fleet air-defence radar

sensor.range_power.note: radar-equation exponent (inverse-4th-power family); standard engine default, not sourced per-platform

sensor.aspect_influence.note: 0.0 disables RCS aspect-angle modeling, consistent with this packet's simplified surface-search detection model

sensor.doppler_notch_width.note: no public MTI/doppler-notch figure; engineering estimate consistent with the packet's other large naval AESA modules

sensor.reference_snr_db.note: radar-equation calibration constant paired with reference_range_m/reference_rcs_m2 to reproduce max_range at a reference target; no public figure

sensor.reference_range_m.note: paired radar-equation calibration constant, see reference_snr_db

sensor.reference_rcs_m2.note: 5 m^2 generic warship/large-aircraft reference RCS, engine convention used across this packet's naval radar records

sensor.antenna_height_m.note: no public integrated-mast height for Type 055; engineering estimate typical of a large destroyer/cruiser integrated mast

sensor.target_height_bias_m.note: no public figure; engineering estimate consistent with the packet's other naval AESA modules (horizon-geometry bias term)

sensor.environment_domain.note: surface/maritime domain selected for a shipborne air/surface search radar per authoring standard

sensor.sea_clutter_enabled.note: disabled, consistent with this packet's simplified detection model; no sourced clutter-suppression figure exists to calibrate an enabled model

sensor.enable_ducting.note: standard engine atmospheric-ducting toggle, enabled consistent with the packet's convention for a long-range search radar

sensor.ducting_gain_factor.note: engineering estimate consistent with the packet's other naval AESA modules

sensor.ducting_max_bonus_m.note: engineering estimate consistent with the packet's other naval AESA modules

modeling_notes: The X-band mast panels (fire-control/horizon-search) are not separately modeled as a second sensor record; the engine's single sensor_ref/sensor_refs convention for ships treats the ship's radar fit as merged records, consistent with the DDG-51 SPY-1D(V) pattern.
